shared_elements: frontal standing anthropomorphic figure carved in low relief
broad elaborate headdress/head-band occupying the top register
horizontal dividing band separating upper and lower zones
arms bent and held symmetrically against the torso
paired eye/face-like motifs within the headdress zone
lower garment or skirt covered in incised linear/hatched patterning
bilateral symmetry about a vertical axis
justification: Both depict a frontal, bilaterally symmetric anthropomorphic figure organised into the same stacked zones: an oversized ornamented headdress on top, a horizontal dividing band, a torso with a central pectoral ornament and symmetrically bent arms, and a lower skirt/apron filled with incised linear motifs, all in flat schematic low relief. The most specific difference is that B's headdress contains distinct paired face/eye masks and its lower zone has dense angular hatched panels, whereas A's chest is dominated by a plain concentric disc and its lower zone by broad curved bands, so the individual motifs differ even though the compositional scheme matches closely.
